title: kb-lane job on GitLab and GitHub
goal: .gitlab-ci.yml has a kb-lane job (an image with git, GIT_DEPTH 0) that runs kbgit.py check-lanes on push pipelines of the default branch, triggered as its lane-job-trigger gate says; .github/workflows/kb.yml has a kb-lane job (fetch-depth 0, the token permission TK-yoyjegdq found, if: vars.KB_PUBLIC_HOME != 'true') that runs it on pushes to the default branch with before..after from the event; TestCiLaneJob in _tools/test_ci_config.py asserts both as text

gates.question: Every GitLab job is manual with allow_failure: true, so a manual kb-lane job detects nothing until someone starts it and never fails the pipeline. How does kb-lane run on pushes to main?
options: automatically with allow_failure: false: main's pipeline turns red on a direct code commit, and backlog.py red-pipeline files a bug for it
automatically with allow_failure: true: a warning on the pipeline only
gates.recommendation: automatically with allow_failure: false: main's pipeline turns red on a direct code commit, and backlog.py red-pipeline files a bug for it
gates.answer: automatically with allow_failure: false: main's pipeline turns red on a direct code commit, and backlog.py red-pipeline files a bug for it
